item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
"I bloody well know it's easy to tell! In case you've forgotten, I've been in this business since before you were born, you sniveling welp!" Mr. Dark barked at Carter, who manged to hide his flinch almost completely.

Nooooo. Dialogue tag's gotta go earlier. Plus other awkwardness. Fix suggestion:

"I bloody well know it's easy to tell!" Mr. Dark barked. Mr. Carter almost managed to hide his flinch. "In case you've forgotten, I've been in this business since before you were born, you sniveling welp!"

…though the problem there is that it feels like it's from Carter's POV. Hrm. Oh well, just an example.

Overall I'm not sure what I think of this. The take on Dark is only okay (to me, at least — I see others liked it). The competition idea is a good one, but… I dunno. I feel interested in where this is going, but… I'm not sure what I think of this.
